title: Connection String Contract Compiler
description: Compiles the per-environment, per-service connection string contract. Enforces: no literal passwords in connection strings (vault references only), SSL required for non-local environments, every environment and service has a host entry, services are isolated, and connect_timeout is defined.

error_codes.CSC001: connection-string-contract.json missing or invalid — required fields: environments[], services[], connections[]
error_codes.CSC002: Literal password detected in connection string — use a vault path or environment variable reference (e.g. ${DB_PASSWORD} or vault://secret/db)
error_codes.CSC003: sslmode is not require or verify-full for a non-local environment — all non-local connections must enforce TLS
error_codes.CSC004: Environment is missing a host entry — every declared environment must have a database host defined
error_codes.CSC005: Services share a connection string — each service must have its own dedicated connection string for auditability and least-privilege
error_codes.CSC006: connect_timeout is not defined — all connection strings must declare a connect timeout to prevent indefinite hangs
error_codes.CSC007: Connection string format is inconsistent — all entries must use the same format (all URI or all DSN, not mixed)
